structure.type: npm workspaces monorepo, ESM, root package name 'frisson'; workspaces packages/* and apps/*; node >=22.18, .nvmrc 22

workspaces.packages/shared: @frisson/shared; zod; exports ./src/index.ts and ./sorting; only a typecheck script
workspaces.apps/api: @frisson/api; Fastify 5, better-sqlite3, drizzle-orm, sharp, fastify-type-provider-zod; src/{plugins,routes,services,db}; migrations in apps/api/drizzle (0000-0002); runs .ts directly via node, no build
workspaces.apps/web: @frisson/web; Vue 3, Pinia, vue-router, Vite 6; build = vite build to apps/web/dist; dev proxies /api and /covers to 127.0.0.1:3000

app_assembly.app.ts: buildApp(opts: dbPath, coversDir, auth, webDir) returns an unstarted Fastify; logger off when NODE_ENV=test; trustProxy from TRUST_PROXY; Zod validator/serializer compilers set
registration_order: authPlugin (adminPassword/sessionSecret/production from env, overridden by opts.auth)
webPlugin (last; static + SPA notFound handler; no-op unless dir/WEB_DIR set)
app_assembly.server.ts: imports buildApp, listens on PORT (3000) / HOST (127.0.0.1)
app_assembly.auth_hook: onRequest hook blocks write methods under /api/ (except /api/session) unless canEdit; modes: open (no password, non-prod), login (password set), read-only (no password, production)

docker_ci.Dockerfile: multi-stage node:22-bookworm-slim (manifests, web-build, api-deps, runtime); runs node apps/api/src/server.ts as user node; /data volume; healthcheck /api/health
docker_ci.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml on PR and push to main; job check: npm ci, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build; job docker: image build + smoke test

tests.runner: vitest ^3.2 in api and web; no vitest config file in apps/api (defaults); web config inline in vite.config.ts with environment happy-dom; @vue/test-utils for components

root_commands.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present (runs vitest run in apps/api and apps/web)

tests.api_tests: apps/api/test/*.test.ts: albums, auth, covers, crates, health, schema, sorting, web (about 71 it() cases); web tests are 7+ *.test.ts colocated in apps/web/src

helpers.buildTestApp(): mkdtemp covers dir in tmpdir, buildApp({dbPath ':memory:', coversDir}), onClose hook removes the dir; caller must app.close()
helpers.TestApp: type alias of the resolved buildTestApp return
helpers.addCrate(app, name, sortOrder): inserts a crate directly via app.db and drizzle schema
helpers.multipart(field, fileName, contentType,: hand-built multipart body returning payload and headers

tests.db_in_tests: in-memory SQLite; createDb runs drizzle migrations from apps/api/drizzle on every build, foreign_keys ON
tests.request_style: app.inject(); no ports opened; auth.test.ts and web.test.ts call buildApp directly with auth / webDir options; default test app has no password so is in open mode

conventions.format: Prettier: no semi, single quotes, width 100, trailingComma all. EditorConfig: 2-space, LF. ESLint 9 flat config (eslint-plugin-vue essential + vue-ts recommended + prettier skip-formatting). Scripts: lint, format, format:check, typecheck, test.
conventions.naming: Package scope @frisson/*. Imports use .ts extensions (native TS on Node >=22.18). API files lowercase/kebab (error-handler.ts); plugins export xPlugin, routes export xRoutes (FastifyPluginAsyncZod), services are plain functions (db, input) such as listCrates/getCrate. Web: PascalCase .vue, useX composables/stores, api/ one file per resource.
conventions.api: app.ts buildApp registers errorHandlerPlugin, authPlugin, dbPlugin, coversPlugin, then routes under /api prefix, webPlugin last. Zod schemas in route schema {params, body, response}. Services throw HttpError/notFound/badRequest (errors.ts); services never touch reply.
conventions.errorShape: { statusCode, error, message, issues? } (ApiError in @frisson/shared); handler order: zod validation 400, response serialization 500, HttpError, fastify 4xx, else 500.
conventions.shared: packages/shared/src/index.ts: zod 4 schemas, input schemas named xInput, entities plain names, inferred types; exports ./ and ./sorting (no zod). Section dividers with box-drawing comments.
conventions.web: Pinia setup stores (library, session) using ref/computed/functions; api/client.ts request<T>() with ApiRequestError and errorMessage(); api modules call request. Stores import api as namespace or named fns.
conventions.tests: Vitest; api tests in apps/api/test, web tests colocated *.test.ts.

documentation.auth: README 'Who can edit' table: ADMIN_PASSWORD set = browse public, editing needs Staff log in; unset in dev/test = open; unset in production = read-only. Logins 30 days, rate limit 10 per 15 min, password change logs everyone out; SESSION_SECRET decouples. Single shared admin password, cookie frisson_session; no per-user accounts. Matches code in plugins/auth.ts.
documentation.adminPassword: Required by compose (:? check), .env.example says deployment refuses to start without it (app itself only goes read-only). DEPLOY.md suggests openssl rand -base64 24; change by editing .env and docker compose up -d.
documentation.deployEnvVars: ADMIN_PASSWORD, DOMAIN (no http:// for real certs), SESSION_SECRET (optional), TRUST_PROXY=true set in compose, DATA_DIR/DATABASE_PATH/COVERS_DIR/WEB_DIR documented in README.
documentation.futureAccounts: Absent. SPEC section 8 only says 'read-only public mode plus a simple admin login'. ADR 0003 says fail closed. No ADR or doc mentions multi-user, accounts or roles. ADR 0001 says single-user collection.
documentation.staleness: DEPLOY.md and README still reference crate-digger: git clone URL github.com/ThomF/crate-digger, cd crate-digger, crate.db, crate-data volume, crate-backup (db filename and volume likely intentional); README title says Frisson. SPEC calls self-hosting '(later)' while README says deployment done.

api.guarding: No per-route preHandler. One global onRequest hook in auth.ts L98 gates all write methods under /api/. Routes (crates.ts, albums.ts, covers.ts) have no auth code and no req.user. Write routes: crates.ts L27 POST,L33 PATCH,L40 DELETE,L45 PUT(order); albums.ts L41 POST,L47 PATCH,L53 DELETE,L59 PATCH,L67 POST(spins),L73 PUT; covers.ts L9 POST,L22 DELETE. Services in apps/api/src/services/{crates,albums,covers}.ts take no user param; crates select list at services/crates.ts L8-13 (id,name,color,label,sortBy,sortOrder) and shared `crate` zod at packages/shared/src/index.ts L118
